newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lira set to rejoin ERM at 990 to mark.
newsitem.headline: Lira set to rejoin ERM at 990 to mark.

text.p: European Union finance ministers agreed on Sunday that the Italian lira would enter the EU's exchange rate mechanism at 990 lira to the German mark, Eu diplomats said.
They were waiting for final confirmation from national capitals, the diplomats said.
The agreement came after an eight-hour meeting at which EU countries made it clear to Rome that they were not willing to see the lira re-enter the currency grid at a weak rate.
Italy had asked for a rate as weak as 1,010 lira to the mark, officials said.
